It holds interest in Ying silver-lead- zinc project located in the Ying Mining District in Henan Province, China; and GC silver-lead-zinc mine in Guangdong Province, China. The company was formerly known as SKN Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Silvercorp Metals Inc. in May 2005.

ACEINTEG-SM.NS.d: ACE INTEGRATED SOL likely provides integrated solutions, potentially including IT services, consulting, or other business solutions, based in India

APOLLOHOSP.NS.d: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare services in India and internationally. The company's healthcare facilities comprise primary, secondary, and tertiary care facilities. Its tertiary care hospitals provide care in approximately 55 specialties, including cardiac sciences, oncology, critical care, neurosciences, orthopedics, gastroenterology, and transplants.

ASTRAL.NS.d: Astral Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets pipes, fittings, and adhesive products in India and internationally. The company operates through Plastic Products and Adhesives segments. It offers chlorinated poly vinyl chloride (CPVC) and PVC plumbing systems for residential and industrial applications. The company offers pipes and fittings under the Astral CPVC Pro, Astral Pex-a PRO, and Astral Aquarius names; and surface drainage systems.

ATMASTCO.NS.d: Atmastco Ltd. is an Indian engineering company primarily engaged in providing Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services within the ferrous and non-ferrous sectors. The company designs, manufactures, and supplies precision equipment and heavy fabrication structures, including girders, columns, and ducts, utilized in power, energy, steel, cement, railway, water treatment, refinery, and fertilizer plants, as well as general industrial and infrastructure projects.

BIRLACORPN.NS.d: Birla Corporation Limited manufactures and sells cement in India. The company operates through three segments: Cement, Jute, and Others. It offers ordinary Portland, Portland Pozzolana, and Portland slag cement under the MP Birla Cement Perfect Plus, MP Birla Cement Samrat Advanced, MP Birla Cement Ultimate Ultra, MP Birla Cement Unique, MP Birla Cement Samrat, MP Birla Cement Ultimate, MP Birla Cement Chetak, MP Birla Cement PSC, MP Birla Cement MULTICEM, and MP Birla Cement CONCRECEM brand names that are used in…

BLBLIMITED.NS.d: BLB Limited provides securities brokerage services in India. It trades and invests in shares, securities, and commodities. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in New Delhi, India.

CEMPRO.NS.d: Cemindia Projects Limited is a civil engineering and construction contractor based in Mumbai, established in 1931, working throughout India. Its marine work includes jetties, quays, berths, wharfs, dry docks, breakwaters, dredging, land reclamation and coastal erosion protection. It also operates in the transportation sector.

COLPAL.NS.d: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited manufactures and trades in personal and oral care products in India. The company offers toothpastes, toothpowder, toothbrushes, mouthwashes, and dental gels under the Colgate brand, as well as specialty products under the Colgate brand name. It also provides soaps, cosmetics, and toilet preparations. The company offers a range of personal care products, such as shower gels and liquid hand washes under the Palmolive brand name. It also exports its products.

DELHIVERY.NS.d: Delhivery Limited is a Gurugram, India-based company founded in 2011 that provides supply chain and logistics services across India. Its clients include e-commerce platforms, direct-to-consumer brands and businesses in FMCG, consumer durables, electronics, retail, automotive and manufacturing.

EUROTEXIND.NS.d: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited was established in Mumbai, India, in 1987 and produces, exports and distributes cotton yarns and knitted fabrics. Its yarns include autoconed, compact, gassed, TFO knotless and soft precision wound types.

FRACTAL.NS.d: Fractal Analytics Limited supplies artificial intelligence and analytics services that help businesses automate workflows, draw insights from data and run operations more efficiently. Its offerings include engineering solutions for retail and supply chains, self-serve analytics platforms, proprietary AI-based algorithms and conversational business intelligence tools.

GENUSPAPER.NS.d: Genus Paper & Boards Limited manufactures and sells kraft paper in India. The company operates through two segments, Kraft Paper Business and Strategic Investment Activity. It also invests in shares and securities, and loans. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in New Delhi, India.

GSLSU.NS.d: Global Surfaces Limited mines, produces and trades natural stone and engineered quartz internationally. Its natural stones include granite, marble, soft quartzite, phyllite and soapstone, while its engineered quartz lines include Stratum, Prismatic, Lampros, Kalmasa and Aurora. The company was established in 1991.

HPAL.NS.d: HP Adhesives Limited makes and distributes adhesives and sealants in India and abroad, including solvent cement, contact adhesives, PVA glue, epoxy products, spray paints, cyanoacrylates and sealants. It also supplies plumbing accessories, ball valves, tapes and drainage products such as manhole and gully covers, for plumbing, glazing and building facade uses.

ICIL.NS.d: Indo Count Industries Limited manufactures and sells home textile products in India. It offers bed sheets; fashion bedding products, such as matching and complementary sheets, comforters, duvet covers, quilts, pillows, shams, and skirts; utility bedding products; institutional bedding products, which include matching sheets, comforters, duvet covers, quilts, pillows, shams, euro-shams, and skirts; and bedding products, such as flat sheets, printed bed sheets, fitted sheets, and bed skirt/valance.

IRCTC.NS.d: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Limited provides catering and hospitality, Internet ticketing, travel and tourism, and packaged drinking water services in India. The company offers mobile catering services, including on-board catering management services through pantry cars on trains; train side vending contracts on mail/express and superfast trains; and pantry cars re-designing and development services.

JAINAM.NS.d: Jainam Ferro Alloys (India) Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer and exporter primarily focused on ferro alloys. The company produces manganese-based alloys such as Ferro Manganese and Silico Manganese, which are essential additives in the steelmaking process to enhance properties like hardness, durability, and corrosion resistance. Additionally, it engages in the trading of manganese ore, a vital raw material for ferro alloy production.

KARMAENG.NS.d: Karma Energy Limited engages in the generation of power from renewable energy sources in India. It develops and operates wind farms in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu. The company also operates a 3.5 MW small hydropower ProjectKarma Energy Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.

KIRLOSBROS.NS.d: Kirloskar Brothers Limited provides fluid management solutions in India and internationally. The company manufactures various pumps, including end suction, split case, multistage, special and engineered, monobloc, vertical turbine, submersible, and sump pumps. It also provides valves, such as butterfly, sluice, non-return, kinetic air, foot, gate, suction diffuser and triple duty, ball, and steam trap, as well as cast steel gate, globe, and check valves; and forged steel gate, globe, and check valves.

LAKSHMIMIL.NS.d: The Lakshmi Mills Company Limited is involved in the textiles business. The company manufactures and sells a range of textile products including yarn and fabric. The Lakshmi Mills Company Limited is based in Coimbatore, India.

MARUTI.NS.d: Maruti Suzuki India Limited manufactures, purchases, and sells motor vehicles, components, and spare parts primarily in India, rest of Asia, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and Latin America. The company offers passenger vehicles, multi utility vehicles, and multi-purpose vehicles. It is also involved in the facilitation of pre-owned car sales, fleet management, and car financing. In addition, the company offers driving school, accessories, insurance, auto card, pre-owned car, and financing products and services.

MMWL.NS.d: Media Matrix Worldwide Limited is an India-based company engaged in providing IT and digital media solutions. The company offers services such as software development, website design, and digital marketing, headquartered in Mumbai, India.

MOTILALOFS.NS.d: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited provides financial services in India. The company operates through Broking and Other Related Activities, Fund Based Activities, Asset Management and Advisory, Investment Banking Services, and Home Finance segments. It offers broking and distribution services, such as equities, derivatives, commodities, currency, depository services, portfolio management services, mutual funds, primary equity offerings, and insurance products; and asset management services.

NAHARPOLY.NS.d: Nahar Poly Films Limited manufactures and sells bi-axially oriented polypropylene films in India and internationally. It provides metalissed and unmetalissed sealable and non-sealable films that are used in flexible packaging. The company was formerly known as Nahar Investments and Holding Limited and changed its name to Nahar Poly Films Limited in June 2008. Nahar Poly Films Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

NAUKRI.NS.d: Info Edge (India) Limited operates as an online classifieds company in the areas of recruitment, matrimony, real estate, and education and related services in India and internationally. It operates through Recruitment Solutions, 99acres, and Other segments.

NEUEON.NS.d: Neueon Corporation Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker NEUEON and traded in INR. Its country is India.

ONESOURCE.NS.d: OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited is a biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, makes and commercializes biological drug products, mainly injectables, with operations in India, Ireland and the US. It provides contract development and manufacturing for biologics from preclinical stages to commercial supply, and supplies drug-device combinations such as prefilled syringes and pen injectors.

ORTEL.NS.d: Ortel Communications Limited, a regional cable television service provider, engages in the distribution of analog and digital cable television, high speed broadband, and voice over Internet protocol services. It operates through Cable TV, Broadband Service, Infrastructure Leasing, and Others segments. The company offers digital cable television services; and other value added services, such as high definition (HD), near video on demand, electronic program guide, and gaming and local content services.

OSWALSEEDS.NS.d: ShreeOswal Seeds and Chemicals Limited is an Indian company that grows, processes and distributes agricultural seeds, including isabgol, mung, maize, black gram, mustard, soybean and wheat. It also trades general agricultural produce and exports.

PARAS.NS.d: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited is an Indian company with international reach that designs, develops, makes and tests engineered products for defense and space customers. Its offerings include networking, communication, display and computing systems, command and control, flow-formed tubes, avionics suites, automated test equipment, and optical and ultra-precision manufacturing.

RITCO.NS.d: Ritco Logistics Limited, founded in 2001 and headquartered in Gurugram, India, provides supply chain and logistics management. Its services include dedicated contract logistics, less-than-truckload and liquid transportation, warehousing and distribution, and fleet management.

RPEL.NS.d: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited, headquartered in Jaipur, India, makes, distributes and sells ramming mass and other quartz-based materials. Its main products are silica ramming mass and refractory products used to line furnaces, incinerators, kilns and reactors, in India and abroad.

SAYAJIHOTL.NS.d: Sayaji Hotels Limited is an Indian hospitality company that owns and operates a chain of hotels across India. They provide accommodation, food and beverage, and event services to both business and leisure travelers. The company is headquartered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

SBIFUNDS.NS.d: SBI Funds Management Ltd. provides asset management services, among them wealth management solutions, mutual fund management, investment advisory and portfolio management. It was founded on 7 February 1992 and has its head office in Mumbai, India.

SEAMECLTD.NS.d: Seamec Limited owns and operates multi support vessels for providing support services to offshore oilfields in India and internationally. Its services include vessel management, marine management, dive support, firefighting, subsea construction, ROV support, pipe laying, rescue operations, logistics, mooring and de-mooring, and carnage services. The company also operates bulk carrier vessels for providing bulk carrier services.

SHEMAROO.NS.d: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited engages in the motion picture, video, and television programme distribution activities in India. The company is involved in the movie production; and syndication business that distributes its content to satellite, cable, and terrestrial networks, as well as distributes videos, CRBT, live streaming, etc. through operator and own branded portals. It also deals in curating and providing content to DTH services on DTH platforms; and provides inflight eclectic mix of content service.

SHYAMMETL.NS.d: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Kolkata, makes and sells steel and ferro alloys in India. Its steel products include structural steel, TMT bars, wire rods, sponge iron, iron pellets and billets, and it also produces and distributes aluminium foil.

SILKFLEX.NS.d: Silkflex Polymers (India) Ltd. is a company operating in the specialty chemicals industry, primarily focused on the manufacturing, trading, and distribution of water-based polymer products for the textile printing and wood coating sectors in India. The company's main offerings include a diverse portfolio of water-based textile printing inks, which encompass eco-based, non-PVC, screen coatings, glues, specialty effects, additives, and colors.

SKFINDIA.NS.d: SKF India Limited manufactures and supplies products, solutions, and services in the area of rolling bearings, seals, mechatronics, and lubrication systems primarily in India. It offers rolling bearings, bearings accessories, engineered products, and track rollers; and mounted bearings and housings, super-precision bearings, slewing bearings, plain bearings, magnetic bearings and systems.

SOBHA.NS.d: Sobha Limited engages in the construction, development, sale, management, and operation of residential and commercial projects primarily in India. The company operates through two segments, Real Estate, and Contractual and Manufacturing.

SOLARA.NS.d: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (API). The company offers APIs for anesthetics, anthelmintic, anti-arrhythmic agent, anti-asthmatic, anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, anti-Parkinson, anti-viral, antibiotic, anticoagulant, anticonvulsant, antidepressant, antiemetic, antiepileptic, antifungal, antigout agent, antihistamine, antihyperlipoproteinemic, antimalarial, antimycotic, antineoplastic detoxifying agent, antiprotozoal agent, ant psoriatic,…

SOLARWORLD.NS.d: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SOLARWORLD and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SONACOMS.NS.d: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited is an international automotive technology company that designs, makes and supplies systems and components worldwide. Its electric vehicle products include e-axles, controllers, traction motors and integrated motor control units, and it also supplies powertrain and gearing components such as differential bevel gears.

SPLPETRO.NS.d: Supreme Petrochem Limited, established in Mumbai in 1989, makes and distributes petrochemical products worldwide. Its portfolio includes polystyrene in expandable, high-impact and general purpose grades, expandable polystyrene on its own, and specialty polymers and compounds.

SSRETAIL.NS.d: SS Retail Limited runs a multi-brand retail chain selling mobile phones, tablets, accessories and smart TVs in Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Goa. Siddharth Gunvant Shah founded the company on June 14, 2016, and it is headquartered in Kolhapur, India.

SUBEXLTD.NS.d: Subex Limited provides operations and business support systems to communication service providers (CSPs) worldwide. The company offers ROC Revenue Assurance, a solution that helps CSPs enhance CX minimize risk, manage margins, and get business insights true business assurance; and ROC Fraud Management solution to protect operator's voice and SMS services, data services, and new-age digital services from consumer, partner, and internal fraud.

TARC.NS.d: TARC LIMITED (formerly Anant Raj Global Limited) is an Indian real estate development company. The company focuses on developing residential and commercial properties in the Delhi NCR region. TARC Limited is based in New Delhi, India.

TECHNOCRAF.NS.d: Technocraft Ventures Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TECHNOCRAF and traded in INR. Its country is India.

UFLEX.NS.d: Uflex Limited manufactures and sells flexible packaging products and solutions worldwide. Its Packaging Films division offers biaxially oriented polyethylene terephthalate (BOPET) films; biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films; cast polypropylene (CPP) films; metallized BOPP, BOPET, and CPP films; special effects films; and AlOx coated films.

VELJAN.NS.d: Veljan Denison Limited manufactures hydraulic equipment and systems. The company provides hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, and power units used in various industries. Veljan Denison Limited is based in India.

WIPRO.NS.d: Wipro Limited operates as an information technology (IT), consulting, and business process services (BPS) company worldwide. It operates in three segments: IT Services, IT Products, and India State Run Enterprise Services (ISRE).
